mapper.select: SELECT PO_NO AS poNo , PO_DT AS poDt , VEND_CD AS vendCd , ITEM_CD AS itemCd , QTY AS qty , UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice , PAY_TERM AS payTerm , STTS_CD AS sttsCd FROM TB_PO WHERE PO_NO = #{poNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PO (PO_NO, PO_DT, VEND_CD, ITEM_CD, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, PAY_TERM, STTS_CD, REG_DT) VALUES (#{poNo}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{vendCd}, #{itemCd}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{payTerm}, 'R', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT PO_NO AS poNo, PO_DT AS poDt, VEND_CD AS vendCd, STTS_CD AS sttsCd FROM TB_PO WHERE PO_DT < '20180101' ORDER BY PO_NO
